extraCharacters.name: Bắp
extraCharacters.description: Bắp, a short round prehistoric man, black buzz-cut hair, one buck tooth, tiny round eyes, leopard-print hide wrap tied at the waist, stubby arms, bare feet

extraCharacters.name: Bà Then
extraCharacters.description: Bà Then, an elderly prehistoric woman, gray hair in a tight bun, deep wrinkles, narrow sharp eyes, leopard-print hide dress, bone bracelets, slightly hunched

extraCharacters.name: Sói
extraCharacters.description: Sói, a small scruffy yellow-brown wolf pup, oversized ears with one bent tip, big expressive eyes, thin legs, bushy tail

extraCharacters.name: Lugal
extraCharacters.role: Vua Sumer, xuất hiện khi kể chuyện đế chế
extraCharacters.description: Lugal, a broad-shouldered Sumerian ruler, shaved head, thick black beard in tight curls, heavy brows, fleece kaunakes skirt, copper crown, copper armbands, bare feet
